vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2025-0134
vulnerability.description: rustls-pemfile 2.2.0 — unmaintained; PEM-parsing functionality merged into `rustls` upstream

statements.impact_statement: RUSTSEC-2025-0134 is an unmaintained-status advisory, not a vulnerability. `rustls-pemfile` 2.2.0 is feature-complete; its PEM-parsing surface was absorbed into `rustls` upstream, leaving the standalone crate in maintenance mode. Springtale uses it directly (`springtale-transport`) to load mTLS certs from disk and transitively (`irc` crate); both call sites feed controlled local-filesystem inputs.
statements.action_statement: Migrate Springtale's direct usage to `rustls::pki_types::pem` once the upstream API stabilizes; track `irc` crate for the same migration. No production exposure given trust boundary.
